implementation_formula.rounding: Exact Decimal/rational through final ROE percentage: two decimals, half away from zero. Repeating margin division uses input scale + 24 fractional digits.
implementation_formula.intentional_difference: Website rounds 1/leverage to five decimals; app uses exact reciprocal to avoid intermediate precision loss.

boundaries: Reference project production mapper carries server unrealizedPnlPercent; its review ledger is simulation, not authoritative Aster formula.
ROE percentage uses initial margin even when isolated allocation includes additional funds.
Only linear marginAsset==quoteAsset contracts with known units, positive mark and leverage qualify.
Zero position/debt-only, missing PnL/entry/leverage remain unknown.
Events clear missing leverage; public marks cannot revive obsolete ROE.
Snapshot and public-mark estimates have separate labels; stale flags remain.
Not Portfolio historical performance, account returns, available funds or a liquidation calculation.
